method: Preserve URLs with verified 90-day Search Console demand or a unique core-site function; hold thin template URLs noindex until original, source-backed value is added. 2026-09-03: index TX/CA/AZ state-law pages and unique tools (letter/calculator/compare). Company hubs stay redirected to existing blogs. Do not restore the ~276 thin city pages from the July spam-penalty recovery. Florida and Nevada stay in trustQuarantine.

trustQuarantine.reason: Unsupported legal, outcome, fee, timeline, complaint, or authority claims found by the pre-deployment source-governance launch gate.
